notes.title: New Game Announcement + Graceward Autumn Sale Update - Nov 21st
notes.content:
Good evening, I have a few announcements.

Firstly for one week Graceward, and the Graceward soundtrack will be half off as part of the Autumn Sale.

And in even more rousing news, I'm pleased to announce that my next game, Stormwater will be available in early-access come next month in late December. Stormwater is a spiritual successor to Graceward which takes the action-adventure hybrid style even further, and dives much more into hauntings, creeds, and of course meticulous pixelated-violence. 

Here is a small teaser for Stormwater, featuring the delightful track #8 from the game, "Summer Sun".
[previewyoutube=3ffb16mXruE;full][/previewyoutube]

More information on Stormwater to come!

Godspeed,
Fransis

notes.title: Graceward Spring Sale Update - Mar 15th
notes.content:
Good evening, I have a few announcements for Graceward news. 

Firstly for one week Graceward will be 50% off as part of the Steam Spring Sale!

On top of that, the game's original soundtrack, which is also on sale at the moment, can now be purchased on Steam here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2222990/Graceward__Complete_Edition_Soundtrack/

It's almost three hours long, and as always, the composer, Shelbee Michael, put together a fairly spectacular range of music for it, so be sure to check it out.

Next, I've added an achievement guide for the game to Steam, which can be found here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2947391586

It covers all thirty six achievements in the game, and may be of great assistance to the completionists among us, or even just returning players who are interested in finding some of the game's secrets.

Lastly, there is demo for a new project currently in the works, so expect more on that as the year continues.

That's all for now, if you have any bugs or questions make a post, or shoot me an email at thelibraryupstairs@gmail.com .

Godspeed,
Fransis

notes.title: Minor Update - Jan 14th
notes.content:
A small patch for Graceward is now live, fixing:

- Instability for some upgrade paths in the character skills.

- Several other small bugs/typos.

Also the soundtrack for the game will be available for download coming next week, more on that later!

Godspeed out there,
Fransis

notes.title: Minor Update - Dec 28th
notes.content:
A small patch for Graceward is now live, fixing:

- The Wasteland Merchant prices running far higher than intended.

- Flag for Glass Tower Solo achievement.

- Several other small bugs/typos.

Godspeed out there,
Fransis
